spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    (
        rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_inserted)) +
        rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_updated)) +
        rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_deleted)) +
        rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_fetched)) +
        rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_returned))
    ) AS total_tuples_rate_per_sec
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', collected_at) AS bucket,
        collected_at,
        tup_inserted,
        tup_updated,
        tup_deleted,
        tup_fetched,
        tup_returned
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
) sub
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_inserted)) AS inserted,
    rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_updated)) AS updated,
    rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_deleted)) AS deleted,
    rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_fetched)) AS fetched,
    rate(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_returned)) AS returned
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', collected_at) AS bucket,
        collected_at,
        tup_inserted,
        tup_updated,
        tup_deleted,
        tup_fetched,
        tup_returned
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
) sub
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    (
        rate(counter_agg(collected_at, xact_commit)) +
        rate(counter_agg(collected_at, xact_rollback))
    ) AS total_xact_rate_per_sec
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', collected_at) AS bucket,
        collected_at,
        xact_commit,
        xact_rollback
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
) sub
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    rate(counter_agg(collected_at, xact_commit)) AS commits,
    rate(counter_agg(collected_at, xact_rollback)) AS rollbacks
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', collected_at) AS bucket,
        collected_at,
        xact_commit,
        xact_rollback
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
) sub
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  temp_files - LAG(temp_files) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS temp_files,
  temp_bytes - LAG(temp_bytes) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS temp_bytes
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) 
ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  deadlocks
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT
    'PostgreSQL' AS component,
    current_setting('server_version') AS version

UNION ALL

SELECT
    initcap(extname) AS component,
    extversion AS version
FROM pg_extension
WHERE extname LIKE 'timescale%'
ORDER BY component;
SELECT extract(epoch from current_timestamp - pg_postmaster_start_time()) as "Uptime"

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  db_size
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) 
ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT
    bucket as time,
    (
      delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blk_read_time)) +
      delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blk_write_time))
    ) AS blk_io_time_ms
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', collected_at) AS bucket,
        collected_at,
        blk_read_time,
        blk_write_time
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
) sub
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT
    bucket as time,
    (delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blks_hit)))::double precision
      / NULLIF(
          delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blks_hit))
        + delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blks_read)),
          0
        ) * 100.0 AS cache_hit_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', collected_at) AS bucket,
        collected_at,
        blks_hit,
        blks_read
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
) sub
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_locks
FROM pg_locks
WHERE database = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database())

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '$__interval', collected_at) AS time,

  -- Average total latency per query (planning + execution)
  (delta(counter_agg(collected_at, total_plan_time)) +
   delta(counter_agg(collected_at, total_exec_time)))
   / NULLIF(delta(counter_agg(collected_at, calls)), 0) AS "Avg query latency",

  -- Average I/O time per query (read + write)
  (delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blk_read_time)) +
   delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blk_write_time)))
   / NULLIF(delta(counter_agg(collected_at, calls)), 0) AS "Avg I/O time",
  
  -- Average rows returned per query
  delta(counter_agg(collected_at, rows))
   / NULLIF(delta(counter_agg(collected_at, calls)), 0) AS "Avg rows per call"

FROM pganalyze.stat_snapshots
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
GROUP BY time

SELECT
  time,
  load15 / cpu_count * 100 AS "CPU (total $cpu_count)",
  (mem_total - mem_avail) / mem_total::double precision * 100 AS "RAM"
  FROM pganalyze.sys_stats
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

WITH user_hypertables AS (
    SELECT hypertable_schema,
           hypertable_name
    FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables
    WHERE hypertable_schema NOT LIKE '_timescale%'
),
all_chunks AS (
    SELECT
        c.hypertable_schema,
        c.hypertable_name,
        ch.chunk_name,
        ch.is_compressed
    FROM user_hypertables c
    JOIN timescaledb_information.chunks ch
      ON ch.hypertable_name = c.hypertable_name
     AND ch.hypertable_schema = c.hypertable_schema
),
chunk_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        ac.is_compressed,
        cds.total_bytes
    FROM all_chunks ac
    JOIN LATERAL chunks_detailed_size(ac.hypertable_schema || '.' || ac.hypertable_name) cds
       ON cds.chunk_name = ac.chunk_name
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_compressed = false THEN total_bytes ELSE 0 END) AS "Rowstore",
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_compressed = true THEN total_bytes ELSE 0 END) AS "Columnstore",
    SUM(total_bytes) AS "Storage used"
FROM chunk_sizes;

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(
    wal_lsn,
    LAG(wal_lsn) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at)
  ) AS wal_bytes
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
